name: cavemio-search-input
title: Search input
description: The field at the top of every list: ⌘K focuses it from anywhere, search runs after a pause, the magnifier blurs into a spinner while it loads.

cavemio.usage:
import { SearchInput } from "@/components/search-input";

<SearchInput placeholder="Search customers" loading={isFetching} onSearch={(q) => setQuery(q)} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- Shares field.tsx with every text control: one surface, one focus ring, one way of showing hints and errors.
- role="searchbox"; the shortcut hint is aria-hidden (the key is a convenience, not a name).
- The browser's own cancel button is hidden in favour of the folding one.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.
